title: Two days in Da Nang
summary: My Khe and An Thuong on the first day. Son Tra and the Marble Mountains on the second, with Hoi An still an easy ride if the hills are enough.

days.title: Day 1 — Beach and An Thuong
days.body: My Khe in the morning, mi Quang for lunch, and An Thuong after dark. The Cham Museum if you want the hour on the river first.

days.title: Day 2 — Peninsula and the hills
days.body: Linh Ung Pagoda on Son Tra, then the Marble Mountains on the road toward Hoi An.

stops.name: Mi Quang
stops.note: Lunch between the museum and the beach.

stops.name: My Khe Beach
stops.note: The morning and the swim. An Thuong is the walk inland after dark.

stops.name: An Thuong
stops.note: Day one, after dark. Kalà Kalà is on the sand. East West faces the water.

stops.name: Linh Ung Pagoda, Son Tra
stops.note: Day two. The ride is part of the visit.

stops.name: Marble Mountains
stops.note: On the way toward Hoi An. Skip it if Son Tra used the day.
